_: REV 2026-09-06 (SNN-9). These used to be frozen literals inside cochlea.py with no date and no corpus, and the GUI printed a win/lose verdict against them forever. A number is a baseline only for the corpus it was measured on, so every entry now carries WHEN it was measured, on WHAT, and by whom. cochlea.py falls back to the same literals if this file is unreadable, so nothing breaks if it is missing.
fingerprint_note: Measured 2026-09-06 over the wavs as they sit on disk. Every one of the 528 files has an mtime between 2026-08-21 19:46:52 and 19:47:04 and none has been written since, so this fingerprint IS the corpus the 2026-08-21 numbers below were measured on. If a wav is ever re-recorded, added or relabelled, this sha changes and train.py refuses to print a win/lose against the organism until the baseline is re-measured.
